title: GMAT
description: Documented public mission design software (NASA Goddard (open source)) for the Mission Architecture Generator capability area.
body:
GMAT is a documented mission design software from NASA Goddard (open source). NASA's open-source General Mission Analysis Tool for trajectory design, optimization, and mission analysis from LEO to interplanetary.

How it works: It works by computing the two Hohmann transfer burns from the vis-viva equation and the half-ellipse transfer time.

Documented uses of this capability area include interplanetary trajectory design, space-station operations, lunar base planning, and asteroid resource assessment.
